findings.evidence: Energy.lean:317-321: `have hX {K} (hK : ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1) (uncurry K) W) : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun p ↦ ω.hamiltonianVectorField (K p.1) p.2) W := fun p hp ↦ (ω.contDiffAt_hamiltonianVectorField_uncurry ((hK p hp).contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hp))).contDiffWithinAt; exact (contDiffOn_const.smulRight (hX hKs)).add (contDiffOn_const.smulRight (hX hKt))`. The diff's `hXK`/`hX` has the same shape, with only the extra `P` coordinate reshuffling.
findings.fix: Generalize `contDiffOn_hamiltonianOneForm` (Energy.lean:313) to `Ks Kt : P → ℝ × ℝ → V → ℝ` with `W : Set (P × ((ℝ × ℝ) × V))` and hypotheses on `fun q ↦ Ks q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2`. Use it here as `have hX := ω.contDiffOn_hamiltonianOneForm (n := 2) hW hKs hKt` and update its caller in `CylindricalEnd.lean` (`contDiff_hamiltonianOneForm_comp_equivRealProdCLM`) to the `P = Unit` case. That removes `hXK`/`hX`; the `ContinuousOn` input for `exists_forall_norm_fderiv_stdComplexLineReal_sq_le_parametric` then comes from `hX.continuousOn.clm_apply continuousOn_const`, as in the pre-PR proof.
findings.issue: In the new `SymplecticForm.exists_pos_forall_tendsto_tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_subseq_off_finset`, the local steps `hXK`/`hX` (per-point `contDiffAt_hamiltonianVectorField_uncurry` lifted to `contDiffWithinAt`, then `contDiffOn_const.smulRight ... .add ...smulRight`) re-derive the body of the existing `SymplecticForm.contDiffOn_hamiltonianOneForm` with a parameter `P` added. The old proof called that lemma; now the same proof exists in two places.

summary: The parametric compactness theorem and its capped-family application are new, and the single-datum results are now derived from them rather than duplicated. The one problem is that the parametric proof rebuilds the body of `SymplecticForm.contDiffOn_hamiltonianOneForm` with a parameter added instead of generalizing that lemma.
